attributes.contentHtml:
Hello everyone,

I'm trying to create a site for publishing my adult content in VR.

From the documents I managed, with a lot of effort, to ensure that the site is read by the DeoVR player.

But it only shows me videos without any search filter and othe features.

The information in the documentation is very basic.

I would like to create a site like DeoVR with search filters, comments, likes, and a reserved area for subscribers.

I saw that a site (maybe there are others) https://jillvr.com

which is virtually identical to DeoVR.com

Can you tell me who to contact to create a site like this, or send me more in-depth documentation to understand things to include in my site to better integrate with the DeoVR platform?

Thank you

Afaik DeoVR can operate in four modes, SLR, DeoVR, Json and JillVR. All but Json modes are determined by the URL and are hardcoded. Json mode is used when there is a hostname/deovr endpoint, which you have been using. There is also the plain browser.

You can on a plain browser just have links to videos and those open in the player, but you have to select the projection manually (or use a filename that DeoVR can use to deduce the projection). If you want to provide metadata through json then one option you have other than using using the full on Json mode is to combine the plain browser with the Json mode. For example I am working with a rich interface on a normal plain website with many links to subdomains as a way to communicate extra information to the /deovr endpoint to determine which videos it should show in the gallery based on interactions on the rich site. For example I have a.domain.test/deovr and b.domain.test/deovr and the subdomains resolve dynamically so I can use any ID there to correlate with things on the server. The only downside I can think of is that credentials are different per subdomain, but for me that is no use case. This allows me to both make a nice UI as well as use the extra features available through the Json mode.

This was more a side hobby thing just for fun, I wouldn't rely on any of this for anything serious as this behavior can and has changed with each release without warning. Json mode is clearly not a first class citizen.
